components.name: PredictionMarket
components.doc: A market card for a yes or no question: the price of each outcome, the probability over time, and an order ticket with a live payout estimate. Picking the other outcome flips the line to that outcome's history, numbers count to their new values, and the confirm button walks through sending and done. All amounts are play money.

components.name: PredictionMarketPreview
components.doc: Ready preview with fixed sample data.

members.name: id
members.doc: Stable key of the range, such as "1w".

members.name: label
members.doc: Short label on the range switch.

members.name: points
members.doc: Probability of "yes" over time, each from 0 to 1. Every range must have the same number of points so the line can morph.

members.name: labels
members.doc: One label per point for the readout, such as "Oct 12" or "14:00".

members.name: side
members.doc: The outcome that was bought.

members.name: amount
members.doc: Amount spent, in the market's currency.

members.name: price
members.doc: Price per share, from 0 to 1.

members.name: shares
members.doc: Shares bought: amount divided by price. Each share pays 1 if the outcome happens.

members.name: question
members.doc: The question the market settles.

members.name: category
members.doc: Small label above the question.

members.name: ranges
members.doc: History of the "yes" probability, one entry per time range. The last point of the active range is the current price.

members.name: defaultRange
members.doc: Range shown first. Defaults to the first one.

members.name: volume
members.doc: Traded volume, already formatted.

members.name: closes
members.doc: When the market closes, already formatted.

members.name: side
members.doc: Selected outcome (controlled).

members.name: defaultSide
members.doc: Selected outcome on first render (uncontrolled).

members.name: onSideChange
members.doc: Called when the outcome changes.

members.name: defaultAmount
members.doc: Amount in the field on first render.

members.name: balance
members.doc: Play balance available to spend. It goes down as orders are placed.

members.name: onPlaceOrder
members.doc: Called when an order is confirmed. Return a promise to keep the button in its sending state until it settles.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the card.
